시편-25-1.title: 시편 25장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-1.exegesis: 7-10. The entrance of the ark, with the attending procession, into the holy sanctuary is pictured to us. The repetition of the terms gives emphasis.
시편-25-1.theologicalNote: 7-10. The entrance of the ark, with the attending procession, into the holy sanctuary is pictured to us. The repetition of the terms gives emphasis.

시편-25-2.title: 시편 25장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-2.exegesis: PSALM 25 Psa 25:1-22 . The general tone of this Psalm is that of prayer for help from enemies. Distress, however, exciting a sense of sin, humble confession, supplication for pardon, preservation from sin, and divine guidance, are prominent topics. 1. lift up my soul-- ( Psa 24:4 ; 86:4 ), set my affections (compare Col 3:2 ).
시편-25-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 25 Psa 25:1-22 . The general tone of this Psalm is that of prayer for help from enemies. Distress, however, exciting a sense of sin, humble confession, supplication for pardon, preservation from sin, and divine guidance, are prominent topics. 1. lift up my soul-- ( Psa 24:4 ; 86:4 ), set my affections (compare Col 3:2 ).

시편-25-3.title: 시편 25장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-3.exegesis: 2. not be ashamed-- by disappointment of hopes of relief.
시편-25-3.theologicalNote: 2. not be ashamed-- by disappointment of hopes of relief.

시편-25-4.title: 시편 25장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-4.exegesis: 3. The prayer generalized as to all who wait on God-- that is, who expect His favor. On the other hand, the disappointment of the perfidious, who, unprovoked, have done evil, is invoked (compare 2Sa 22:9 ).
시편-25-4.theologicalNote: 3. The prayer generalized as to all who wait on God-- that is, who expect His favor. On the other hand, the disappointment of the perfidious, who, unprovoked, have done evil, is invoked (compare 2Sa 22:9 ).

시편-25-5.title: 시편 25장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-5.exegesis: 4-5. On the ground of former favor, he invokes divine guidance, according to God's gracious ways of dealing and faithfulness.
시편-25-5.theologicalNote: 4-5. On the ground of former favor, he invokes divine guidance, according to God's gracious ways of dealing and faithfulness.

시편-25-6.title: 시편 25장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-6.exegesis: 4-5. On the ground of former favor, he invokes divine guidance, according to God's gracious ways of dealing and faithfulness.
시편-25-6.theologicalNote: 4-5. On the ground of former favor, he invokes divine guidance, according to God's gracious ways of dealing and faithfulness.

시편-25-7.title: 시편 25장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-7.exegesis: 6-7. Confessing past and present sins, he pleads for mercy, not on palliations of sin, but on God's well-known benevolence.
시편-25-7.theologicalNote: 6-7. Confessing past and present sins, he pleads for mercy, not on palliations of sin, but on God's well-known benevolence.

시편-25-9.title: 시편 25장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-9.exegesis: 8-9. upright-- acting according to His promise. sinners-- the general term, limited by the meek-- who are penitent. the way-- and his way--God's way of providence.
시편-25-9.theologicalNote: 8-9. upright-- acting according to His promise. sinners-- the general term, limited by the meek-- who are penitent. the way-- and his way--God's way of providence.

시편-25-11.title: 시편 25장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-11.exegesis: 10. paths-- similar sense--His modes of dealing (compare Psa 25:4 ). mercy and truth-- ( Job 14:1-22 ), God's grace in promising and faithfulness in performing.
시편-25-11.theologicalNote: 10. paths-- similar sense--His modes of dealing (compare Psa 25:4 ). mercy and truth-- ( Job 14:1-22 ), God's grace in promising and faithfulness in performing.

시편-25-12.title: 시편 25장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-12.exegesis: 11. God's perfections of love, mercy, goodness, and truth are manifested (his name, compare Psa 9:10 ) in pardoning sin, and the greatness of sin renders pardon more needed.
시편-25-12.theologicalNote: 11. God's perfections of love, mercy, goodness, and truth are manifested (his name, compare Psa 9:10 ) in pardoning sin, and the greatness of sin renders pardon more needed.

시편-25-13.title: 시편 25장 13절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-13.exegesis: 12-13. What he asks for himself is the common lot of all the pious.
시편-25-13.theologicalNote: 12-13. What he asks for himself is the common lot of all the pious.

시편-25-14.title: 시편 25장 14절 역사문법적 주해

시편-25-15.title: 시편 25장 15절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-15.exegesis: 14. The reason of the blessing explained-- the pious enjoy communion with God (compare Pr 3:21 , 12 ), and, of course, learn His gracious terms of pardon.
시편-25-15.theologicalNote: 14. The reason of the blessing explained-- the pious enjoy communion with God (compare Pr 3:21 , 12 ), and, of course, learn His gracious terms of pardon.

시편-25-16.title: 시편 25장 16절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-16.exegesis: 15. His trust in God is fixed. net-- is frequently used as a figure for dangers by enemies ( Psa 9:15 ; 10:9 ).
시편-25-16.theologicalNote: 15. His trust in God is fixed. net-- is frequently used as a figure for dangers by enemies ( Psa 9:15 ; 10:9 ).

시편-25-17.title: 시편 25장 17절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-17.exegesis: 16-19. A series of earnest appeals for aid because God had seemed to desert him (compare Psa 13:1 ; 17:13 , &c.), his sins oppressed him, his enemies had enlarged his troubles and were multiplied, increasing in hate and violence ( Psa 9:8 ; 18:48 ).

시편-25-21.title: 시편 25장 21절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-21.exegesis: 20. keep my soul-- ( Psa 16:1 ). put my trust-- flee for refuge ( Psa 2:12 ).
시편-25-21.theologicalNote: 20. keep my soul-- ( Psa 16:1 ). put my trust-- flee for refuge ( Psa 2:12 ).

시편-25-22.title: 시편 25장 22절 역사문법적 주해
시편-25-22.exegesis: 21. In conscious innocence of the faults charged by his enemies, he confidently commits his cause to God. Some refer-- integrity, &c.-- to God, meaning His covenant faithfulness. This sense, though good, is an unusual application of the terms.
